questions.prompt: Which statement gives the core rule for “Sensors, actuators, and power safety”?
options: Compile and upload are separate; a successful build does not guarantee the selected port is correct.
Peripheral and pin mappings depend on the board's MCU.
GPIO should drive loads only within documented current limits.
Do not assume Arduino UNO pin mappings apply to a different MCU family.
questions.answer: GPIO should drive loads only within documented current limits.
questions.explanation:
GPIO should drive loads only within documented current limits.
Why: Sensors measure physical quantities; actuators turn electricity into motion, light, or sound. Do not drive motors or relays directly from GPIO; use suitable drivers and protection.
